metadata.title: Lefschetz fibrations with handlebody monodromy
metadata.abstract: We study relatively minimal Lefschetz fibrations over closed oriented surfaces whose monodromy extends over a fixed 3--dimensional handlebody. If $X$ is the total space and $\ell$ is the number of critical points, we prove that $\sigma(X)=-\ell$. Such fibrations with $\ell>0$ exist precisely for fiber genus $g\geq3$ and base genus $h\geq2$, and one can take $\ell=1$ for every such pair. We also show that hyperelliptic handlebody monodromy forces the fibration to be a surface bundle and that every meridian twist, separating or nonseparating, has commutator length two in the handlebody group for $g\geq3$.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: handlebody 单值化的 Lefschetz 纤维化
analysis.workSummary: 证明 monodromy 延拓到固定 handlebody 的 relatively minimal Lefschetz fibration 满足 σ=−ℓ；ℓ>0 存在恰为 g≥3、h≥2，且每对可取 ℓ=1。
analysis.breakthrough: 给精确存在范围和最少一个临界点的实现。
analysis.limitations: hyperelliptic handlebody monodromy 被迫为无奇点 bundle；一般 fibration 不满足所述范围。
